svg.title: Normal expectations: the finite factor obstruction and its transfer under internal conjugacy
svg.desc: Panel 1 illustrates Lemma 5G.1. Let N_0 be an infinite-dimensional finite factor normally and unitally represented on a Hilbert space K, with normalized faithful normal trace tau. A hypothetical normal conditional expectation F from B(K) onto N_0 gives a normal state phi = tau composed with F, with positive trace-class density d and Tr(d) = 1. N_0-bimodularity and traciality give phi(uXu*) = phi(X) for every unitary u in N_0, hence u*d u = d and N_0 d = d N_0. A positive eigenvalue mu of the nonzero compact operator d has a nonzero finite-dimensional eigenspace K_mu that reduces N_0. Restriction gives a nonzero normal unital representation of N_0 on K_mu. The kernel is an ultraweakly closed central ideal of the factor N_0, so this representation is faithful, contradicting the infinite dimension of N_0. Only normal expectations are excluded; faithfulness of F is not assumed. Panel 2 illustrates Proposition 5G.2 using Lemma 5F.2. Let M be a von Neumann algebra on H, let P and Q be unital von Neumann subalgebras of M, and let the outside algebra N be contained in M prime. Let iota be a normal unital isomorphism from N_0 onto N. A hypothetical unitary U in M with UPU* = Q fixes N pointwise. A given normal conditional expectation F_P from P join N onto N transfers to F_Q from Q join N onto N by F_Q(x) = F_P(U*xU). If there is a normal unital star homomorphism psi from B(K) into Q join N whose restriction to N_0 is iota, the composition iota inverse composed with F_Q composed with psi is a normal conditional expectation from B(K) onto N_0, contradicting Panel 1. Thus no such internal conjugating unitary exists under these hypotheses; self-adjointness or an involution hypothesis is unnecessary. Proof locators: Lemma 5G.1, Proposition 5G.2, and Lemma 5F.2, in Principal groupoids with hidden group factors. Human source target: A. Connes, Sur la théorie non commutative de l’intégration, Corollary 11, author-hosted typeset PDF pages 44–45, https://alainconnes.org/wp-content/uploads/ThNonComm.pdf. The obstruction and illustration are original owned research; this figure does not settle the unrestricted existential source assertion.
svg.metadata: Reproducible vector source. Two stacked panels. No raster images, scripts, foreign objects, external fonts, or external resources. Exact proof locators: Lemma 5G.1; Proposition 5G.2; transfer Lemma 5F.2. Human source target: A. Connes, Corollary 11, author-hosted typeset PDF pp. 44–45. Diagram records a general obstruction and its conditional application, not an existential counterexample to the unrestricted source assertion.
svg.text: and its transfer by internal conjugacy
Assume F : B(K) → N₀ is normal.
F is a conditional expectation onto N₀.
φ = τ ∘ F is a normal state.
d has a positive eigenvalue μ > 0.
M ⊂ B(H); P,Q ⊂ M are unital.
N ⊂ M′ is the outside algebra.
ι : N₀ ≅ N is normal and unital.
Then UnU* = n for every n ∈ N.
ψ|N₀ = ι: it preserves the given copy.
This conclusion uses F_P and the bridge ψ.
Human source target: A. Connes, Corollary 11,
